sourceInputs.sourceAuditReason: StudyMY audit JSON stays safe_to_import=false by contract; this importer publishes only after explicit operator command and maps rows to not-available-for-international.

writePolicy.universityRow: upsert by code UITM or slug universiti-teknologi-mara-uitm
writePolicy.programmeRows: upsert 164 current UiTM undergraduate reference rows and archive non-current UiTM bachelor rows

publicationHardGate.standard: UiTM undergraduate may be displayed only as official programme data with international students not open.
rules: no international tuition or application-document inference
direct IELTS retained only where official source directly publishes IELTS

qualityRuleCandidates: For public universities whose official FAQ excludes non-citizens/permanent residents from the target level, force all affected programmes to needs-review/not-available-international and block international tuition publication.
When programme PDFs contain route-specific MUET bands, treat language.muet as non-scalar review data and never convert MUET to IELTS; only direct IELTS strings may populate language.ielts.
When official shortlink/PDF hosting is outside the university domain but linked from an official university page, preserve an authority exception and keep the official page as governing source.
当官方本科目录存在专业代码，但 HEA/e-Syarat/学院页未能给出同一代码的官方英文名时，不得从相邻代码、旧代码或相关学院前缀自动推断 nameEn。
AD/AS、BE/CFAP 等跨学院或跨代码体系的双学位/重编码线索必须进入 source-conflict pending，由 Ian 或官方来源确认后才能双语化专业名称。
国际学生未开放的官方政策可解除国际学费和国际申请材料缺失，但不能解除专业身份、官方英文名、学制等基础字段的来源要求。
若 Ian 明确批准，可用官方马来语专业名生成英文译名补齐展示字段，但必须在 fieldEvidence 标记 isOfficialEnglishText=false，避免冒充官方英文原文。
马来语 Sarjana Muda ... Dengan Kepujian 翻译为 Bachelor ... with Honours 或 (Honours) 时，应优先参考同校 HEA 已发布英文命名风格。
当官方明确某层级不开放国际学生时，该状态应作为 internationalAdmission 备注/展示状态处理，不应继续计入 tuitionMYR/applicationDocs 缺失或专业级验收失败。
When an official e-Syarat page link label/code differs from the linked PDF content, validate the PDF text itself and record the code-label conflict instead of treating the programme as missing.

For UiTM Pharmacy, PH260 appears in the online catalogue and in the official linked PDF, while faculty detail pages may still label the same Bachelor of Pharmacy programme as PH240; keep both sources and scope notes.
